title: Kenyan Vegan Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with Kenyan ingredients, perfect for a vegan meal. This recipe combines the tender texture of fermented vegetables with the rich flavors of Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: such as turmeric, cumin, and coriander

ingredients.name: Fry oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut or avocado oil

ingredients.name: Vegan stir-fry sauce
ingredients.notes: such as tamari or nama shoyu

instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
3. Add the tender vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the fermented vegetables and Kenyan spices and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the vegan stir-fry sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
6. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
